Data table

Opt in with data-table on the table. Sort state lives in aria-sort on the th. Row selection: the row checkbox is the accessible control and aria-selected on the tr is only the styling hook (assistive tech mostly ignores it on a plain table). Other hooks: data-type="numeric" on a cell and data-density="compact" on the table. No classes.

Scroll region with sticky header and selection

The wrapper needs role="region", a name and tabindex="0". Set --pico-data-table-scroll-max-block-size to make it scroll vertically and pin the header. Each row has a checkbox. The Status column is not sortable, so it has no button and no aria-sort.
